notes.title: Prologue Update: reworks, new artefacts, new status effects
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/fb0d6fd1d70973ead17abeaf1b9376ea4d24ba40.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

The latest Legend of Keepers updates have brought a lot of content and improvements. 
As a result, we thought we'd also improve the prologue so that you'll have a game experience closer to the full game.

Here are the [b]main features[/b]:
[h3][list]
[*] [b]Huge reworks[/b] on: [b]runs length and dynamic[/b], [b]starting monsters[/b] as well as an[b] overall balancing[/b]!
[*] [b]20 new Artefacts[/b] to discover!
[*][b] 2 new Status effects[/b]: Guaranteed Critical and Dodge!
[/list][/h3]

We hope you'll enjoy this update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978520/Legend_of_Keepers_Career_of_a_Dungeon_Master/

notes.title: Motivation Update (and new Master with Supporters Edition)
notes.notes:
Hurray my minions! Here's the MOTIVATION UPDATE for Legend of Keepers.

You don't feel motivated at work? Goblinz Studio is glad to show their latest big update for Legend of Keepers.!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/d211566efd63b40034b0b9fc5f78607fb062c1ce.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/25a05628de1613d7ab2c9c9b24050cac2c98fa6a.png[/img]

Legend of Keepers Prologue (this version, Free demo) gets:
- Motivation system with many new features and QoL improvements

Legend of Keepers Prologue - Supporters Edition
- Enchantress Master - Play with this true force of Nature!
- Aztec Environment - This new theme transports you back in time. Ah the classic Aztec theme!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171390/Legend_of_Keepers_Prologue__Supporters_Edition/



Keep in mind the Enchantress and the Aztec Theme will come to you with the early access release of the game on March 26th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/54cc71c832c62873d8771967274bfb7f751a4677.png[/img]

[h1]Motivation Update: 0.6.0 patch notes[/h1]

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Enchantress Master can be played by the owners of the Supporters Edition on Steam!
[*] New dungeon environment: the Aztec Ruins! Available to the owners of the Supporters Edition on Steam!
[*] Enjoy an additional layer of monsters management thanks to the new Motivation system! 
[*] 3 new Artefacts to help you with the Motivation system!
[*] New Task: the Psychologist! Spend your week to let your employees talk about their feelings and let out some steam.
[*] New rare monster: the Jubokko! Scare heroes with this huge demonic living tree!
[*] New monster: the Skeleton Dog! Heroes'd better watch out for their bones!
[*] 7 new random Events have been added to the available pool!
[*] 3 new Plunder locations for your employees!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/f3aa254e4989cdfa96b77e2d2af5fd4d89b6719f.png[/img]

[u][b]Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] A new Motivation system has been added for monsters. They will lose Motivation upon death and will make a burnout for several weeks if their Motivation drops to 0. Send them to the Garrison so they can get Motivation back after a dungeon before it’s too late.
[*] Players can now choose in which rooms their active monsters can be placed in dungeons.
[*] All the players' traps are now available in trap rooms. No more random.
[*] Monsters rooms can now be confirmed even without filling all the slots.
[*] Plunders and Events are now also including Motivation gains or losses.
[*] Business Trips rewards have been improved to include Blood, Tears and Motivation.
[*] Monsters locked after an Event, a Plunder, a Business Trip or making a Burnout are now split into two categories depending on the cause of the lock. They can now be either Injured (Burnout included) or Unavailable. Unavailable monsters can’t be sold at the Black Market.
[*] Random rooms layouts in dungeons have been made more consistent and less punitive.
[*] An explanation dialogue has been added after the first real dungeon defended by players to introduce the Motivation system.
[*] A Motivation window has been added on the Schedule scene after a dungeon defense to display Motivation gained and lost by the employees.
[*] Damage and Morale displayed in attacks tooltips during the Exploration of a dungeon are now taking Bonuses and Penalties in count.
[*] Gold gains displayed everywhere are now taking in count Artefacts gain increase. 
[*] Improved the UI for dungeon map tooltips to better display monsters or traps already placed.
[*] Musics and ambiance have been made even more immersive!
[/list]

[u][b]Balancing:[/b][/u]

There’s so much balancing that has been done for this patch that it would be too long to write all the changes down. 

Here’s a recap list of what has been changed:
[list]
[*] A significant number of monsters stats, attacks and upgrades has been balanced.
[*] Skeleton Warrior stats have been significantly increased to make the Orc Sorcerer more interesting. As a downside, we’ve reduced the chance to resurrect monsters into Skeleton Warriors from the Crystal Skull Artefact. 
[*] Several Slaveholder’s talents have been made more impactful or have been completely reworked.
[*] All heroes stats, some attacks and some skills have been balanced. Tier 1 heroes have been significantly buffed to have stats similar to Tier 2 heroes.
[*] Skill trigger timing of Warrior, Assassin and Elementalist classes has been changed from “at the start of the first fight” to “at the start of each fight”. Number of effect stacks and skill damage have been reduced accordingly.
[*] Several Disasters damage and/or number of effect stacks have been balanced.
[*] Prices to buy and upgrade monsters or traps have been significantly reduced. This change also affects random Events costs. Selling prices at the Black Market have been changed accordingly.
[*] Several random Events have been tweaked to be less punitive. The addition of positive Events in the pool should also help with the general feeling about them.
[*] A fixed Seminar has been added to help players get some more Motivation back if needed.
[*] The random monster given at the start of a run with the other starting monsters has been removed.
[*] The Sacrificial Altar Plunder now gives a level 2 Artefact in exchange for a monster’s soul.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/5421ddd020b8b5690f70fd22e2e7aef858b7c809.png[/img]

[u][b]Bugs fixing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Masters XP gained past max level was not removed when reaching max level for the first time.
[*] Fixed an issue where resurrected of transformed monsters still had the Bonuses and/or Penalties of the dead or previous monster.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gruesome Surprise hanged corpse was following the hero if it was dealing enough Morale to make the hero flee.
[/list]


[u][b]Hotfixes 0.6.0.1:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where traps which deal morale were not applying the Demoralized effect correctly with one of the Slaveholder’s talent.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters VFX were displayed in Reward cards before appearing.
[*] Fixed a value displayed as 0 instead of 30 in one of the Slaveholder’s talent tooltip.
[*] Fixed missing text tag for the Circle of Mushrooms Plunder.
[/list]


[u][b]Hotfixes 0.6.0.2:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 3 of the fixed starting monsters have been replaced by 3 random monsters before starting a new run. Each master have their own random pool.
[*] Masters’ Speed has been increased by 10.
[*] Goblin’s Blade Thrust attack target has been changed from Front to Back and is no longer applying Bleeding (3). Goblin’s passive has been changed to “Attacks apply Bleeding (3)”.
[*] Skeleton Dog’s passive has been changed to “All monsters in the group gain Enraged (3) at the start of a fight”.
[*] Yetigo’s Strength has been reduced from 60 to 50.
[*] Flame Eater’s base price has been reduced by 50.
[*] Reduced the heroes’ group healing passive from 20% to 15% at the start of each fight.
[*] Removed the Armor Break passive that was incorrectly available in the Warrior’s passives pool.
[*] Sacrificial Altar has been removed from the Plunder Locations pool temporarily.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to drag and drop monsters from Inventory to Garrison even while in a task.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Miraculous Pill Artefact wasn’t affecting monsters burnout duration correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue with an Enchantress’s talent where attacks applying a DoT effect couldn’t  apply additional stacks correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters’ Fire Resistance increase on the Trainer level up preview was not displayed. 
[*] Fixed the missing Treant type icon in tooltips.
[/list]

notes.title: Icy Winds Update: 0.5.4.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/63d25ec6ec2171f14d543cfa200ea1bffda8c11c.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/07fb5f3b80d8ff922e8dd713f009d330c0b7a0b4.gif[/img]

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 2 new monsters: the Ice Elemental and the Wind Elemental!
[*] 2 new Artefacts for Elementals!
[*] Alchemist task revamp!
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Alchemist task no longer allows you to transmute an artefact into something else. Instead, you can now transmute Blood and Tears into other resources.
[*] The Alchemist task will now be available more often (only in new runs).
[*] Monsters are now sorted by category and level in the inventory window.
[*] Cards in Business Trip, Seminar, Sanctuary, Workout and Alchemist tasks are now clickable even if they include some hoverable UI elements.
[*] Hovering a master’s stat upgrade in the rewards window will now display the master’s tooltip.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs fixing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Lure trap and the Multiaction effect interaction was not working as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue causing disasters to apply effects before dealing damage or Morale.
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes’ passives were not applying the correct amount of effect stacks.
[*] Fixed an issue also allowing monsters and traps to be drag & dropped with the right mouse button in the inventory window, causing unwanted behaviors.
[*] Fixed an issue where master’s spells values were not refreshed correctly when being balanced between two game updates.
[*] Fixed several typos.
[/list]

[u][b]Hotfixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing traps to apply effects before dealing damage or Morale.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing heroes to be hovered in the Disaster room.
[*] Fixed an issue where reward card borders were not loaded correctly for rare monsters or traps when initialized.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wizard class skill wouldn’t work correctly when used after the first monsters room because of the Mouth Shutter trap.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Inventory when swapping monsters between the active team and the Garrison. 
[/list]

notes.title: Preparation Phase Update: 0.5.3.3 patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750594/3d180b0d1612402eb48694e645aa03df191db898.png[/img]

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New rooms preview during preparation! You can now mouse over rooms to check the monsters and traps available in the next rooms or which ones have already been placed in the dungeon.
[*] Players can now go back to the previous room during dungeons to change the monsters or trap placed in the previous rooms.
[*] 2 new monsters: Dark Magus and Fire Elemental! 
[*] Halloween event has ended. Pumpkin head skeletons got their head back and dungeons decorations has been removed and put away for next year.
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Schedule scene background is now displaying the last dungeon environment the player has been defending.
[*] UI for effects displayed during fights has been revamped to be able to display up to 8 effects at the same time on fighters.
[*] Effects duration are now displayed with a color to better distinguish Bonuses and Penalties.
[*] Fighters turn order has been improved to be loaded before being shown on the screen.
[*] Added a visual quality option in the Settings.
[*] Added sounds for the Elementalist.
[*] Hoplite’s passive icons in his fighter tooltip are now highlighted or grayed out to better distinguish in which stance he is.
[*] Added a visual FX on the Hoplite to better distinguish in which stance he is.
[*] Added a visual FX on master’s Life bar in Schedule scene when healed or damaged during tasks.
[*] A lot of improvements have been done for clickable elements sounds.
[*] Several improvements have been made to some attacks, skills and projectiles visual FX.
[/list]

[u][b]Balancing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] All heroes’ skills have been reworded to make them clearer.
[*] Elementalist class's attack will now only jump once to the next monster if the target is killed.
[*] Elementalist class's skill will now be used on the monster with the lowest Ice Resistance instead of the first monster.
[*] Assassin class's skill has been changed to 8 stacks of Poison applied to the monster with the highest Life instead of 50% instant damage dealt.
[*] Ice Mage’s Power has been reduced from 70 to 60.
[*] Ice Mage’s Slowed stacks applied by her attack have been reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] Morale dealt by attacks are now scaled on monsters’ Power.
[*] Orc’s level 3 Frenzy attack is now dealing 50% increased damage to heroes affected by Bleeding instead of applying Vulnerable to self. Frenzy’s Power scaling ratio has been reduced from 1.5 to 1 accordingly.
[*] Goblin’s base speed has been increased from 110 to 120.
[*] Goblin’s level 3 passive is now applying an additional effect stack if the target is not affected by this effect instead of dealing 100% more damage on targets that had not taken any damage.
[*] A lot of balancing has been made to the monsters stats and attacks upgrades when leveling them up.
[*] Terrified effect is no longer increasing Morale taken from effects such as Demoralised. It is now only doubling Morale taken from attacks and traps.
[*] Armor and Resistance reductions from Broken Armor, Fire Weakness, Ice Weakness, Nature Weakness and Air Weakness effects has been reduced from 50% to 40%.
[*] Gold gained from plunders, trip missions and events where monsters or traps were involved have been balanced correctly and are now also tied to the monster(s) level. Plunders were in a right spot, but events and trip missions rewards have been changed accordingly.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs fixing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing players to experience a black screen when loading a run in progress that had been started before the addition of a new class of hero.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to hang after the Elementalist attack or skill was used under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Lost Adventurer Event displaying the wrong Tears gain on the “Scare” choice button.
[*] Fixed an issue with Show No Mercy’s spell description displaying wrong information.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Flame Eater’s Spontaneous Combustion attack would grant the player more Blood than intended if the Burn damage of the remaining stacks was dealing overkill damage to the hero.
[*] Fixed an issue on the reward screen where hovering the far right element could result in the tooltip from the trap in the room to be displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Master’s Intimidation Spell was applying Terrified before dealing Morale to heroes. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/a2cbf94db97f09ba3db6631196f8fbe5b824116f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/c0fa7d0fbbb78c7894cb63b908215b0af409f94f.gif[/img]

[h1]Halloween Update: 0.5.3 & 0.5.3.1 patch notes[/h1]

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Halloween is hopping into the game for a few weeks!
[*] New monster: The Ice Skeleton! Freeze!
[*] New trap: The Pile of Bones! Yet another tool to scare heroes away!
[*] New heroes passives!
[*] Vampires Collectors can now be paid with Blood!
[*] 3 new Steam achievements!
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements and balancing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud saves are now functional!
[*] Changed several monsters attacks to apply Demoralised instead of Terrified.
[*] Ice Skeleton Power has been reduced from 90 to 60.
[*] Targets visual indications have been added in traps and skills tooltips.
[*] Price reduction for Creatures in talents have been buffed.
[*] Added sound when fighters are running.
[*] Added more available resolutions in the settings.
[*] Giving a run up without playing the first dungeon won’t give players experience anymore.
[*] Negative events can’t be dodged by putting all your monsters and traps in your garrison or stock anymore.
[*] The amount of Blood, Tears and Gold gained in a dungeon are now displayed on the rewards screen with a short explanation label.
[*] Traps and skills tooltips have been improved.
[*] Turn order list has been improved to better identify monsters and heroes, as well as fighters that have already play their turn.
[*] Team management tabs visuals have been improved.
[*] Alchemist results when transmuting an artefact have been greatly improved.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/c1cd388d53511671a5699cc6fffe6fab3aee3734.gif[/img]

[u][b]Bugs fixing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed heroes immunity passives and Pile of Bones trap missing tags in tooltips.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Artefact replacement window to work correctly in the Schedule scene.
[*] Fixed several issues preventing some Events from being available in the random pool.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Succubus attacks from bouncing to the hero in the back if the hero in the middle had been killed or scared.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters were locked without being moved to the Garrison.
[*] Fixed master level not loaded correctly in save slots and in the Schedule scene.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Orc Frenzy remnant taunt mechanic causing enemies to use attacks on him instead of the correct target.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Artefact achievement to register correctly when upgrading an Artefact through Events or Alchemist.
[*] Fixed an issue where maxed out Talents tooltip were not displaying the correct value.
[*] Fixed an issue with ultra wide screens where the game was not was not choosing a proper automatic resolution.
[*] Fixed an issue with traps having a long track that were being displayed in other reward cards.
[*] Fixed an issue where a dungeon was not ended correctly after a Morale trap had scared the last hero.
[*] Fixed an issue with the trap triple kill achievement not working correctly with a few specific traps.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the max level monster achievement to be unlocked when hovering a monster without even upgrading it.
[*] Fixed an issue causing price reduction talents for specific monster types to be applied to all monsters instead.
[*] Fixed an issue where killing and scaring a hero with the same attack was giving blood and tears at the same time. It will now only give blood. Dead heroes can’t flee.
[*] Fixed all resolutions issues, including ultra wide screens. If you’re still experiencing any issues with this, please contact us on the forums or on our Discord.
[*] Fixed the unwanted ability to click on another save slot during the hiding animation of the saves window when loading or creating a save.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Stun icon was displayed above fighters even if the Stun was not applied.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Independent Herbalist event to be randomly chosen incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Pile of Bones trap to bounce incorrectly.
[*] Fixed several typos.
[*] Added a security to check master’s life when entering the Schedule scene to avoid players being tempted to use game closing glitches.
[/list]

notes.title: Prologue Demo Release on October 10th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/99b283d82ee009539eb248fbd6ddf06ce8f48189.png[/img]

We're glad to announce we will release a new demo version of Legend of Keepers on October 10th! It will feature new game mechanics such as blue tears and red tears. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151080/Legend_of_Keepers_Prologue/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/a0efafaf4e2a4ea312641def5f0c655dcb2a91fc.png[/img]
These are new ingame rewards that will allow you to diversify the options you pick at the trainer or other events. It will improve replayability a lot!

Blue tears are gained when you deplete the morale of a hero.
Red tears are gained when you kill a hero during a dungeon.

We hope this will give more weight to those two options while playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/95bf3c1bde9528ea8b4319ce40062fa38ac62ddb.png[/img]

The skill tree will improve your game session customization. You will have several traits to upgrade your monsters, traps and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/866a4e6037bcec49e310431a1be4894a0310f549.png[/img]

The snow theme will diversify the game experience. The classic dungeon is a must, but what about those icy caverns? It's a must-have in all dungeons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/a763df2d809a75daac032546939436ee674bc689.gif[/img]


On October 10th, see you on this page to get the demo for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151080/Legend_of_Keepers_Prologue/
